# FinAI backend — Milestone 1+2 dependencies.
# Pinned to versions supporting BOTH host Python 3.13 and container Python 3.11.
# Do NOT edit the repo-root requirements.txt (that holds the prototype pins).

# --- Web framework / server ---
fastapi==0.115.6
uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0
python-multipart==0.0.20          # form parsing (login/register form-encoded fallbacks)

# --- Config / validation ---
pydantic==2.10.4
pydantic-settings==2.7.1
email-validator==2.2.0             # EmailStr support for pydantic

# --- Database ---
asyncpg==0.30.0                    # async driver (app runtime; statement_cache_size=0 for pgbouncer)
psycopg2-binary==2.9.10            # sync driver (Alembic migrations against Postgres directly)
alembic==1.14.0

# --- Redis ---
redis==5.2.1                       # includes redis.asyncio

# --- Auth / crypto ---
PyJWT==2.10.1                      # RS256 sign/verify (preferred over python-jose)
cryptography==44.0.0               # RSA key handling + Fernet
bcrypt==4.2.1                      # password hashing (cost 12)
zxcvbn==4.4.28                     # password strength scoring
pyotp==2.9.0                       # TOTP MFA (M2, §1D)
Authlib==1.4.0                     # Google OAuth2 flow (M2, §1F)

# --- Middleware / observability ---
slowapi==0.1.9                     # rate limiting (Redis-backed via limits)
structlog==24.4.0                  # structured JSON logging
sentry-sdk[fastapi]==2.19.2        # error tracking (disabled when SENTRY_DSN empty)

# --- Email ---
resend==2.6.0                      # transactional email (dev fallback logs to stdout)

# --- Tests ---
pytest==8.3.4
pytest-asyncio==0.25.0
httpx==0.28.1                      # ASGI test client
